HMRC statistics: pre-release access list

HM Revenue and Customs' record of those who have pre-release access to Official Statistics.

From:
HM Revenue & Customs
Published:

Last updated:

Documents

HMRC statistics pre-release access list

HTML

Details

HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) maintains a record of all of those who have pre-release access to HMRC’s Official Statistics.
